primary_source.authors: Galyna Livshyts, Grigoris Paouris, Peter Pivovarov
primary_source.title: On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures
primary_source.transferred_scope: unit linear aggregate over a disjoint original-coordinate bank has density cap sqrt(2) under independent cap-one input densities

completed_result_used.scope: three independent cap-one variables plus invertible symmetric 3x3 quadratic matrix gives continuous density bounded by (2*pi+3*sqrt(3))/sigma_min(B)

designated_partner_result_applied.scope: exact three-bank factorization with a definite Schur pivot; determinant-sensitive density bound

proved_claims.scope: three disjoint product-valid unit aggregates, arbitrary outside affine coupling, arbitrary invertible symmetric compressed 3x3 B; continuous density with exact cap-rescaled sigma_min bound and <=(4*pi+6*sqrt(3))/sigma_min(B) under cap-one physical inputs

A_m=C_m B_* C_m^T with B_*=(2+sqrt(3))*[[1,2,1],[2,1,1],[1,1,1]] has nonzero eigenvalues [-(2+sqrt(3)),1,7+4sqrt(3)], no definite scalar-pivot Schur complement, yet density <=4*pi+6*sqrt(3) for all m and all cap-one product inputs

first_unresolved_implication: QFORM-BANK-EXTRACTION-WITH-REMAINDER-v1: from the bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis, either enter the diffuse/ridge-window branch or extract product-valid disjoint aggregates with a uniformly nonsingular compressed matrix while controlling all non-bank remainder without destroying conditional density caps.
